beats.summary: Jim decides to invest ten thousand dollars in a business venture to appear as a team player.

evidence.snippet: Jim: We were thinking somewhere between five – ten thousand? I can do the full ten thousand. We should just – – all in.

beats.summary: Andy shares the story behind his nickname 'Boner Champ' related to a Spring Sing performance in 1995.

beats.summary: Angela is upset about the food arrangement at a Halloween gathering and looks for Phyllis to address it.

evidence.snippet: Angela: Wait a second, who designed this spread? The sweets and savories are all mixed together. This is mayhem!
